chunks: That he, peace be upon him, performed twenty Hajj pilgrimages discreetly, and in all of them he would pass by al-Maʾzimayn, then dismount and urinate.

key_terms.بِالْمَأْزِمَيْنِ: at the two mountain passes known as al-Maʾzimayn

ai.seo_question: What does this narration say about his repeated practice during Hajj at al-Maʾzimayn?
ai.summary: This report states that he عليه السلام performed twenty Hajj pilgrimages discreetly. It also preserves a repeated detail from his practice on the route, namely that he would pass by al-Maʾzimayn, dismount there, and urinate.
